verdict.rationale: Evidence shows dbt Projects on Snowflake explicitly supports 'orchestrate' as part of the dbt lifecycle (implying scheduled/recurring transformation jobs) and Snowpipe/Streams enable event-driven or incremental data loads, but there is no direct documentation of Snowflake's native Task/cron scheduling object or CLI-driven recurring job scheduling in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit docs on native scheduled TASK objects, cron-based recurring execution, and CLI/agent-driven schedule management.
